sidewall_multiblend_bake.method: unchanged source triangles; original UV/weights/softness/tintmask/linear vertex colour evaluated in per-face barycentric atlases;1pixel clamped pad
sidewall_multiblend_bake.geometry: source XYZ and face order preserved exactly; no simplification or culling

lighting: offline smooth source normals and fixed daylight; local depth contact shading
scope: Tree-free original geometry background only. No runtime pack, game source or old resource modified. Dedicated trees, tree aggregates and entity trees omitted; static structures and original terrain retained. Fixed-camera RGB/depth for later cut-tree restoration, not a claim of unrelated-pixel identity with the existing baked panorama.

parameters.double_light_audit: Original map bake fixed daylight/contact occlusion only; no RenderDeferredLight, particle cookie or dynamic fountain light is included. Original fountain bake did not load this cookie. Artist albedo is not treated as an already evaluated dynamic light.
parameters.adaptation: Static seeded alpha, original point-light radius/tint/falloff/cookie. H1 fixed-camera diffuse normal estimate/inverse-square response; not the Source2 deferred photometric shader. Spotlight FOV unused because original LightDistance=0 (point light).
